Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on analyzing sales performance, optimizing ad campaigns, and planning international expansion strategies.
Key issues included lower sales on Swiggy, ad campaign performance variations, bulk order data visibility, and image misuse by a third-party website.
Follow-up actions involve refining ad targeting, conducting competitor analysis, addressing legal issues regarding image misuse, and enhancing URL structures.
Decisions were made to optimize marketing strategies, improve sales tracking, and proceed with international expansion plans, including integrating payment systems for global audiences.
